prediction_text: He shall die by BEHEADING — a violent death by an edged weapon at the hands of men, in public execution, not a natural death in prison. The 9th-house cusp is taken for his Ascendant (a man of the Church); Saturn, lord of that sign, is in his fall, long retrograde, in the 12th of the figure — imprisonment and disgrace. The Moon separates from Saturn and applies to the Sun near the cusp of the 8th, and the Sun in a fiery sign applies to an opposition of Mars, the dispositor of the aged Bishop; Mars in an airy and humane sign is the executioner by iron/blade among men, and the Moon wants seven degrees of the body of Mars. The fiery and airy signs make the death public and spectacular rather than private.
basis: tradition: horary（卡面载明）。systems_used: horary（死法占）。已载面：死法（主问）、囚禁状态（题面情境）。断项过闸：斩首←火星居风象人形之宫（人手持刃）＋太阳火象宫趋冲火星＋月亮趋合火星（距7°）三路同指刃杀；非自然死←其象征土星入弱久逆居十二宫（囚辱）而死门（八宫头）有太阳月亮趋会。对象核：承受对象=大主教本人。应期：卡面无成相日期度数可定死期，只断死法、不报死期（无据不报）。
